name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
flagName: Flag of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
summary: A sky-blue field with a yellow-edged red diagonal band and a yellow star in the upper hoist. Adopted in 2006, it closely resembles the flag of 1963–1971.
origin: The Congo Free State of King Leopold II (1885–1908) used a blue flag with a gold star, kept by the Belgian Congo and at independence in 1960, with six small stars added.

From 1963 to 1971 the flag had a red diagonal band. Mobutu's Zaire used a green flag with a torch from 1971 to 1997. Laurent-Désiré Kabila restored a 1960-style flag in 1997, and the 2006 Constitution adopted the current design.

facts: Its single star dates back to the Congo Free State flag of 1885.
Tanzania's flag also has a diagonal band edged in yellow.
The neighbouring Republic of the Congo has a green, yellow and red diagonal flag.
clues: Sky blue with a yellow-edged red diagonal and a yellow star in the corner.
Its star goes back to a 19th-century king's private colony.
Between 1971 and 1997 its country used a green flag with a torch.
